about: Tiny's answers about the PDF-tools site (D190 T2 — no model). Written from the site as it is (11-15): every answer is a fact the site's own pages or code state; every href is a real page here.

entries.a: No. The PDF tools and the workspace run in your browser — the file is read and changed on this device and never sent to a server. Versions you keep are saved in this browser only.
Yes — every PDF tool here is free, with no account needed.

entries.q: How do I edit the text in a PDF?
entries.a: Open the PDF in the workspace and click any line on the page — you edit it where it is, in its own font where the PDF carries it. Or tell me, e.g. “replace 2023 with 2024”.

entries.q: How do I make a PDF smaller?
entries.a: Compress re-encodes the pictures inside the PDF; text stays text. Application forms usually cap uploads at 2–5 MB — in the workspace say “compress it under 2 MB”.
Merge puts several PDFs (or pictures) into one file in the order you choose. In the workspace, Pages → Add files adds them after the open document.

entries.q: Can I convert Word to PDF, or PDF to Word?
entries.a: Both. Open a .docx in the workspace and it becomes a PDF here (text, headings, lists — set in Helvetica). From a PDF, Convert → Word gives a .docx of its text in reading order.

entries.q: How do I sign a PDF?
entries.a: In the workspace's Fill & sign mode: draw, type or upload your signature once, then click where it goes. A PDF's own form fields can be typed into directly.

entries.q: How do I remove my phone number or address?
entries.a: Use Redact in the workspace's Edit mode and draw over it — the words under it are taken out of the file when you download, not just covered.

entries.q: My PDF is a scan — can I search or edit it?
entries.a: Yes: OCR reads the text in the pictures (in your browser — the reader downloads once, about 15 MB). In the workspace, Find text in pictures makes those lines editable.

entries.q: Can I highlight or draw on a PDF?
entries.a: Yes — the workspace's Annotate mode has Highlight, Draw, Box and Note. The marks are written into the PDF when you download it.

entries.q: How do I delete, rotate or reorder pages?
entries.a: The workspace's Pages mode, or just tell me: “delete page 2”, “rotate page 1 left”, “move page 3 to 1”.

entries.q: I made a mistake — can I undo?
entries.a: Undo / Redo (Ctrl+Z) in the workspace, and ↺ Version history restores any earlier version kept in this browser.

I act on your document without AI — replace words, style a line, delete / rotate / move pages, compress, convert, download, find a word, read a page — and I answer questions about the site. Say “help” for examples.
